purpose: The same two seeds as s04, with the consumer in a genuinely separate artifact: its own repository, depending on the provider as a published package installed from the registry at the provider's base-commit version. No file-granularity cuts, no bind mounts.

grading.a_alone: provider repository, A's patch, the provider's own graded tests
grading.b_alone: consumer repository, B's patch, provider from the registry
grading.merge: clean by construction -- different repositories, no shared path
grading.integrated: consumer repository, B's patch, provider rebuilt from A's patch and installed over the registry copy
grading.stealth_flag: whether A's patch leaves the provider repository's own full suite green

pairs.why: timeUntilStale is not exported from query-core's index.ts. A works in the whole monorepo and can see query.ts::isStaleByTime, which it repaired in s03. Once repaired the public API behaves identically and no downstream consumer can break. If this nulls, a package seam is not sufficient on its own -- the contract has to cross it.

core/index.ts does `export * as util`, so floatSafeRemainder is reachable by any consumer of zod/v4/core. A can repair every in-repo caller it likes; a downstream caller of the function itself still breaks.

gold_validation.qc: B alone PASS (registry provider); integrated FAIL under the gold A patch, which does not repair isStaleByTime -- so the seam propagates a provider change end to end
gold_validation.zod: B alone PASS; integrated FAIL under the gold A patch
